notes: Company: mid-stage SaaS player providing in-app help widgets + agent consoles. Knowledge base ~120k docs (articles, transcripts, policies).
Current stack: internal MySQL + object store for blobs, Elastic for keyword search; vector index proof-of-concept using local FAISS. Wants hosted API to avoid infra ops.

Primary ask: embeddings + reranking pipeline for support KB to drive first-response automation and agent assist. Focus: high QPS (700-1k qps peak for search endpoints), modest index size (~120k docs / ~6M tokens), low median latency (<80ms on query path), cost per query sensitivity (target <$0.003/query including rerank).

Model preferences: open-models OK but require deterministic reranker; interested in 2-stage: dense recall by embedding search + lightweight neural reranker for top-50 -> top-5. Also asks about quantized model options and multi-model fallback.
Routing/fallback needs: region-aware routing (NA primary, EU subset), automatic fallback to smaller cheaper model when cost limits hit, model-family compatibility for reranker.
Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML) for console access, audit logs for evaluation queries, optional data residency for EU customer subset. Retention controls: 30/90/forever options.

POC plan agreed: two-week benchmark. Week 1: ingest 120k docs, build embeddings, validate retrieval recall on 150 eval queries. Week 2: integrate reranker, measure P@1/P@5, latency tail, and cost. AE to provide baseline sample dataset (provided 2026-01-10).
Quotes from call: 'Need predictable cost per ticket — CFO will push back without clear unit economics.'; 'We can't afford spikes over 1s p99 for search, customers notice latency.'
Internal stakeholders: Head of Product (decision maker), Platform Lead (technical buyer), Procurement (contract SLOs), Security (controls).
Current posture: POC started 2026-01-21; ingest succeeded; initial embedding throughput good; reranker tuning required. Diego running perf tests.
Open questions: exact tokenization and embedding dimensionality tradeoffs, available batching knobs for high QPS, auto-scaling behavior under spiky traffic, pricing tiers for sustained high QPS.
